services.title: Residential Metal Roofing
services.short: Replacements, repairs and maintenance for homes.
services.text: Replacements, repairs and maintenance on metal roofs for homes, including changing from shingles to metal.
services.imageAlt: A stone and stucco home with a dark standing seam metal roof
body: We work on homes across Houston and the surrounding areas: replacing corroded screws, tracing storm damages or leaks, and changing a shingle roof over to metal.
Panels are cut to your home, and we offer an array of colors to fit your needs.
points: Metal roof accents and metal siding
Cleaning, new caulking and new sealant

services.title: Commercial Metal Roofing
services.short: Replacements, repairs and maintenance for buildings.
services.text: Replacements, repairs and maintenance on commercial metal roofing and siding, from a leak to a new look on your building.
services.imageAlt: A commercial building with a metal roof and metal siding
body: Fixing damages on roofing or siding, repairing leaks or replacing old screws, and an array of other services for commercial buildings.
Panels are cut to your building, and we offer an array of colors, so a repair matches and a replacement gives the building a new look.
points: Fixing damages on roofing or siding
A new look on your building
Maintenance: cleaning, new caulking and new sealant

services.title: Barndominium Roofing
services.short: Roof and siding panels for barndominiums.
services.text: Replacements, repairs and maintenance for barndominiums, including new or replacement siding and roof panels.
services.imageAlt: A dark metal barndominium under construction with large windows
body: Damages, leaks, screw replacements, new or replacement siding or roof panels, and an array of other services for barndominiums.
Panels are cut to your barndominium, so the roof and siding fit it and hold up.

services.title: Metal Roof Repairs
services.text: Fixing leaks and repairing damages on metal roofing and siding, for homes, commercial buildings and barndominiums.
services.imageAlt: A close view of a dark metal roof panel and its seams
body: Leaks, storm damages and corroded or backed-out screws are the repairs we are called out for most, on homes, commercial buildings and barndominiums alike.
We keep your metal roof in good condition, and we price the repair to what the roof needs rather than selling you a new one.
points: Repairing damages on roofing or siding

services.title: Metal Roof Replacements
services.short: Changing over to a metal roof, in your color.
services.text: Changing over to a metal roof, adding a metal roof accent or metal siding, with panels cut to your home, building or barndominium.
services.imageAlt: New metal roof panels being laid across a roof
body: A replacement is a change over to a metal roof, a metal roof accent on part of the house, or metal siding, and panels are cut to your home, building or barndominium rather than cut down from a stock length.
We offer an array of colors to fit your needs, and we put the roof together for Houston weather: heat, heavy rain and wind.
points: Changing over to a metal roof
Panels cut to your home, building or barndominium
An array of colors to fit your needs

services.title: Metal Roof Maintenance
services.text: Cleaning, changing screws, new caulking, new sealant and many more, to keep your metal roof in prime condition.
services.imageAlt: A metal roof ridge running the length of a long building
body: Metal roofing has minimal susceptibility to issues like mold and rot, but screws back out, caulking dries and sealant fails, and those are what let water in years later.
We keep your metal roof in good condition, and we price the work to what the roof needs.

about.title: A family and a team of skilled workers
text: We are a family and a team of skilled workers, led by a roofer with over two decades of experience.
We know what Houston weather does to a roof, and we build for it. We keep your metal roof in good condition and price the work to what the roof needs.
We also support other businesses in our community who help make all of this happen. Welcome to the MVM Metal Roofing family.
about.imageAlt: A worker on a ladder against a home with a new metal roof
